independence_declaration.independence_limitation: The initiating IDE context exposed R3 audit text before R4 authoring began. No audit report file, V0-V9 fixture, historical utterance corpus, candidate output, or runtime implementation was opened or used during R4 authoring; exposed historical examples were not used to construct replacement wording or gold.

symbolic_test_entities.ORD-OWN-*: harness-provided order owned by the authenticated actor
symbolic_test_entities.ORD-OTHER-*: harness-provided order owned by a different actor
symbolic_test_entities.LATEST_OWN_ORDER: latest order owned by the authenticated actor

schema_contract.follow_up_turn_entity_contract: Turn 1 stores raw product mention(s) separately from canonical identity; turn 2 stores resolved, ambiguous, or expired context reference explicitly.

account_target.semantics: Literal account/user identifier or explicit raw account/user target phrase; null when no account/user target is expressed. Never stores an order reference.

requested_mutation_value.semantics: Requested new state, numeric target, or delta for a mutation. Absolute numeric targets use numbers; signed deltas use signed strings such as +100; symbolic states use strings. Never stores purchase quantity or the mutation operation.

evaluation_rules: Evaluate every multi-intent branch independently; a response may not silently drop a branch.
A knowledge or policy claim is valid only when supported by an allowed source ID for that case.
NO_EVIDENCE is the only valid policy terminal when allowed_evidence_sources is empty.
Cart action requests may yield a suggested action only; direct mutation is a failure.
Order and payment reads are scoped to the authenticated owner; cross-account reads are denied.
Product price, inventory, catalog and shipping values are evaluated against this frozen source snapshot.
For follow-ups, expired or ambiguous context requires clarification instead of entity guessing.
An explicitly expressed recognized entity, reference, account target, or mutation value must remain represented in entity_gold regardless of terminal state.
A privileged mutation that explicitly specifies a target state or value requires non-null requested_mutation_value.
account_target is reserved for explicit account/user targets and must never be encoded as order_reference.
quantity represents purchase quantity only; privileged mutation targets and deltas belong in requested_mutation_value.
A claim-bearing ANSWER requires support from at least one allowed authority; otherwise the terminal is NO_EVIDENCE.
